# deed_integrations (Data Source)

Lists Deed's telemetry integrations (never their credentials), optionally of one adapter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_integrations" "prometheus" {
  adapter = "prometheus"
}

output "prometheus_integrations" {
  value = [for i in data.deed_integrations.prometheus.integrations : i.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `adapter` (String) Only integrations of this adapter.

### Read-Only

- `integrations` (Attributes List) Integrations, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `adapter` (String) Adapter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether bindings may query it.
- `has_secrets` (Boolean) Whether credentials are stored.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `last_error` (String) Error of the last failed test.
- `last_test_ok` (Boolean) Outcome of the last connection test (null when never tested).
- `name` (String) Name.
